description: Governor's Office - North Central Province - Appointment Made by Governor of North Central Provincial Council - 19 Officers.
categorisation: This gazette contains ONLY government personnel changes (appointments and acting assignments) with named individuals and their basic titles/positions (e.g., "Commissioner of Motor Traffic," "Secretary of Health," "Director of Education"). It does NOT include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas for these positions, making it a People Gazette according to the classification rules.
